name: meaple-checkout-desktop
description: Aplicativo independente para preencher o checkout da Meaple com perfis locais protegidos por senha.
author: dfelip007

scripts.check: node --check app/main.cjs && node --check app/preload.cjs && node --check app/store.cjs && node --check app/policy.cjs && node --check app/adapter.js
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
